- No new recent errors beyond some older Ollama 500s.

I logged two new tickets for follow-up:
- **TICKET-20260224-004** — WS/proxy/pairing issue
- **TICKET-20260224-005** — ops cron tool allowlist drift

A brief summary was also posted to mission control.
